items.title: Finland Jails Russian Captain And Bosun Over Baltic Cable Damage

items.title: What a Container Actually Costs You: Inside the Terminal’s Cost Puzzle
points: When a shipping container starts its journey, it passes through various stages, with different parties handling it for different reasons.
That is why, in a single journey, the container is invoiced multiple times at different events of the supply chain.
Different charges involved in a single container move: Gate charges: These are the charges from the port terminal as the truck entry and exit fees for carrying the container.

Container Storage charges: Every container terminal has a complimentary container storage timeline (usually 3-7 days) beyond which the terminal operator will start charging the storage fee against the container.
Demurrage: When a container’s free time inside the terminal expires, it is charged by the shipping line as per the shipping line tariff.
Now the same container is sitting longer than the specified free terminal allotted time, which can vary from 3 to 7 days.
After that, the empty container reaches the shipping line after the allotted free time, which again may vary from 3-5 days.
